The network is connected to a constant voltage source of 11V. The magnitude of the current (in amperes, accurate to two decimal places) through the source is ______.
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: in the figure, the 11V voltage source is connected between the upper vertex and the lower vertex of the network. The upper vertex is connected respectively through two resistors labeled R1 to the upper-left node and the upper-right node; between the upper-left node and the upper-right node there is a horizontal R2. It can also be seen in the figure that the upper-left node and the upper-right node are connected to the central intersection through ordinary wires, so these several points are nodes of the same potential. On the left and right sides there is respectively a vertical R1 connecting from this upper/central node to the lower-left and lower-right nodes; from the central node to the lower-left and lower-right nodes there is respectively an R3; between the lower-left and lower-right nodes there is a lower horizontal R2; the lower-left and lower-right nodes are then respectively connected to the bottom vertex through a lower oblique-side R1. Then reason: since the upper-left, upper-right, and central nodes are connected by ideal wires, the upper horizontal R2 is short-circuited. The upper two R1 are in parallel, equivalent to R_top = 1||1 = 0.5 Ω. By left-right symmetry, the potentials of the lower-left node and the lower-right node are equal, therefore the voltage across the lower horizontal R2 is zero, and it has no effect on the equivalent resistance. Each side branch from the central node to the bottom vertex is (R1||R3) + R1 = (1||3) + 1 = 0.75 + 1 = 1.75 Ω. The two identical left and right branches are in parallel, R_lower = 1.75||1.75 = 0.875 Ω. The total equivalent resistance R_eq = 0.5 + 0.875 = 1.375 Ω. The source current I = 11 / 1.375 = 8.00 A.

method.method_draft: First describe the image topology: merge the upper-left, upper-right, and central junction because they are connected by plain wires, so the upper R2 is shorted. The two top R1 resistors are then in parallel: R_top = 1||1 = 0.5 ohm. By left-right symmetry, the two lower side nodes have equal potential, so ignore the lower R2 for equivalent-resistance purposes. Each lower branch from the central node to the bottom apex is (R1||R3) + R1 = (1||3) + 1 = 0.75 + 1 = 1.75 ohm. The two identical branches are in parallel, giving R_lower = 1.75||1.75 = 0.875 ohm. Total equivalent resistance is 0.5 + 0.875 = 1.375 ohm, so source current is 11/1.375 = 8.00 A.

method.method_draft: First describe the image topology and assign the bottom source node 0 V and the top source node 11 V. Merge the upper-left, upper-right, and central junction into one node x because the image shows wire connections between them; keep the two lower side nodes y_L and y_R, connected by the lower R2. Write KCL at x, y_L, and y_R using R1=1, R2=2, R3=3. The connections are: two 1-ohm resistors from 11 V to x; from x to each y node a 1-ohm and 3-ohm resistor in parallel as separate KCL terms; from each y node to ground a 1-ohm resistor; and a 2-ohm resistor between y_L and y_R. Solve the linear equations; by symmetry the solution gives y_L = y_R, so the lower R2 current is zero. Then compute source current as I = 2(11 - V_x)/1. The nodal solution gives V_x = 7 V, hence I = 2(4) = 8.00 A.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：电路图显示一个菱形/桥式电阻网络接在右侧的 11 V 直流电源两端。右侧电源上端为正端、下端为负端。上端电源节点通过导线接到网络顶部顶点，下端电源节点通过导线接到网络底部顶点。图中上方左、上方右与中心交汇点由导线连成同一节点，因此记为节点 x。左右下方两个侧节点分别记为 y_L 和 y_R。可见有两个 R1 从 11 V 顶部节点接到 x；从 x 到每个下侧节点都有一个 R1 和一个 R3 作为并联支路；每个下侧节点再各通过一个 R1 接到底部 0 V 节点；两个下侧节点之间还有一个下方 R2。上方的 R2 两端同属节点 x，因此无电压差。
推理：令底部电源节点为 0 V，顶部电源节点为 11 V，R1=1Ω，R2=2Ω，R3=3Ω。设节点电压为 V_x、V_L、V_R。KCL 写为：节点 x：2(V_x-11)/1 + (V_x-V_L)/1 + (V_x-V_L)/3 + (V_x-V_R)/1 + (V_x-V_R)/3 = 0。节点 y_L：(V_L-V_x)/1 + (V_L-V_x)/3 + V_L/1 + (V_L-V_R)/2 = 0。节点 y_R：(V_R-V_x)/1 + (V_R-V_x)/3 + V_R/1 + (V_R-V_L)/2 = 0。电路左右对称，所以 V_L=V_R=y，故下方 R2 电流为 0。下侧节点方程变为 (y-V_x)(1+1/3)+y=0，即 (4/3)(y-V_x)+y=0，得到 7y=4V_x，所以 y=4V_x/7。节点 x 方程变为 2(V_x-11)+(8/3)(V_x-y)=0。代入 y=4V_x/7，得 2V_x-22+(8/3)(3V_x/7)=0，即 2V_x-22+8V_x/7=0，解得 V_x=7 V。电源电流只经过顶部两个 1Ω 电阻进入网络，因此 I=2(11-V_x)/1=2(11-7)=8 A。

raw_record.original_question: Consider the network shown below with \( R_1 = 1\Omega \), \( R_2 = 2\Omega \), and \( R_3 = 3\Omega \). The network is connected to a constant voltage source of 11V. The magnitude of the current (in amperes, accurate to two decimal places) through the source is ______.
raw_record.final_cot: First describe the image: in the figure, the 11V voltage source is connected between the upper vertex and the lower vertex of the network. The upper vertex is connected respectively through two resistors labeled R1 to the upper-left node and the upper-right node; between the upper-left node and the upper-right node there is a horizontal R2. It can also be seen in the figure that the upper-left node and the upper-right node are connected to the central intersection through ordinary wires, so these several points are nodes of the same potential. On the left and right sides there is respectively a vertical R1 connecting from this upper/central node to the lower-left and lower-right nodes; from the central node to the lower-left and lower-right nodes there is respectively an R3; between the lower-left and lower-right nodes there is a lower horizontal R2; the lower-left and lower-right nodes are then respectively connected to the bottom vertex through a lower oblique-side R1. Then reason: since the upper-left, upper-right, and central nodes are connected by ideal wires, the upper horizontal R2 is short-circuited. The upper two R1 are in parallel, equivalent to R_top = 1||1 = 0.5 Ω. By left-right symmetry, the potentials of the lower-left node and the lower-right node are equal, therefore the voltage across the lower horizontal R2 is zero, and it has no effect on the equivalent resistance. Each side branch from the central node to the bottom vertex is (R1||R3) + R1 = (1||3) + 1 = 0.75 + 1 = 1.75 Ω. The two identical left and right branches are in parallel, R_lower = 1.75||1.75 = 0.875 Ω. The total equivalent resistance R_eq = 0.5 + 0.875 = 1.375 Ω. The source current I = 11 / 1.375 = 8.00 A.
